_comment: Rulebook for the AI Suggested Next Action. The rules in rules.py read these numbers; change them here, bump framework_version, and every cached wording is regenerated because the version is part of the fingerprint.

windows._comment: How long this brand's leads usually take to pay after their first form. Measured per brand from real data; these defaults apply only when a brand has fewer than min_converters paying leads and no usable Brand Brain sales cycle.

tiers._comment: Automatic product-tier inference. Paid amounts are sorted and split into price bands wherever the next amount is more than band_split_ratio times the previous one. Bands with too few payments are merged into their neighbour. A per-brand override replaces all of this.

insufficient_data.title: Review this lead manually
insufficient_data.text: There is not enough activity on this lead to recommend a specific action yet.
insufficient_data.reason_text: This lead has no touchpoints or calls that the system can rely on.

disqualify.title: No action needed
disqualify.text: Deprioritise this lead unless they get back in touch.
disqualify.reason_text: The lead is marked {disqualified_by}, so it should not take up the team's time.

reply_whatsapp.title: Reply on WhatsApp now
reply_whatsapp.text: The lead messaged on WhatsApp and is waiting for a reply. Respond before doing anything else.
reply_whatsapp.reason_text: The last WhatsApp message came from the lead on {whatsapp_last_message_date} and has not been answered.

callback.title: Call back as promised
callback.text: Make the callback the lead asked for.
callback.reason_text: The last call on {last_call_date} ended with a callback request.

onboard.title: Send onboarding details
onboard.text: Welcome the lead to {core_product} and make sure onboarding is complete.
onboard.reason_text: The lead paid {last_core_amount} on {last_core_date}. Focus shifts to onboarding.

nurture_next_tier.title: Plan a retention or upgrade conversation
nurture_next_tier.text: Check in on progress and, where it fits, introduce the next offer.
nurture_next_tier.reason_text: The lead bought {core_product} on {last_core_date}. Focus shifts to retention and expansion.

pitch_core_offer.title: Call to pitch the main offer
pitch_core_offer.text: The lead bought the entry offer. Call to confirm they attended and introduce {core_product}.
pitch_core_offer.reason_text: The lead paid {last_entry_amount} for {entry_product} on {last_entry_date} and has not bought the main offer.

follow_up_objection.title: Follow up on the last call
follow_up_objection.text: Call back and address the concerns raised on the last call.
follow_up_objection.reason_headline: Qualified on a call but has not paid
follow_up_objection.reason_text: The last call on {last_call_date} was marked {last_call_disposition}, but no payment has followed.

retry_contact.title: Send a WhatsApp, then retry the call
retry_contact.text: The last call went unanswered. Send a short WhatsApp message and try calling again.
retry_contact.reason_text: The last call on {last_call_date} was not answered.

call_probe_repeat.title: Call within 24 hours
call_probe_repeat.text: Call to find out what is stopping them from signing up.
call_probe_repeat.reason_headline: Keeps registering but has not bought
call_probe_repeat.reason_text: The lead submitted {form_count} forms between {first_touch_date} and {last_touch_date} and has not been contacted.

call_now.title: Call within 24 hours
call_now.text: Call while the lead's interest is fresh.
call_now.reason_headline: New lead that has not been worked yet
call_now.reason_text: The lead was last active on {last_touch_date} and has not been contacted.

follow_up.title: Follow up on WhatsApp, then call
follow_up.text: Send a follow-up message and call if they respond.
follow_up.reason_text: The lead was last active on {last_touch_date} and has not been contacted.

re_engage.title: Add to a re-engagement campaign
re_engage.text: Add this lead to a WhatsApp or email nurture campaign instead of calling.
re_engage.reason_text: The lead has been inactive since {last_touch_date}.
